name: Rachel
source: The twenty-seven-year-old secretary for Red Crown’s president, [url=/c149560]Ed[/url]. She’s [url=/c19742]Kyle's[/url] main contact person and sometimes confidante. She’s witty and kind, and knows nothing about Kyle’s search for [url=/c149563]Bradley[/url].
